verdict.rationale: Elicit's docs say users can delete papers from their Library, and that deleted items are kept for a stated 30-day window, recoverable throughout, before permanent deletion. This is a real but narrow first-party deletion and retention control limited to Library papers. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, deletion of sessions/chats/uploaded data beyond Library papers, account-level data deletion, admin or enterprise retention policies, any statement on whether user data is used for model training, and independent corroboration.
